description: This is a test source file for the StatusManager component within a Go project. It contains unit tests for caching behavior, status transitions, event broadcasting, and snapshot retrieval related to agent statuses in a distributed system.

classes.name: fakeAgentClient
classes.description: A mock implementation of the agent client used in tests to simulate responses and errors for agent-related operations.

classes.name: testStatusEventHandler
classes.description: A test implementation of the StatusEventHandler interface for capturing status change events in tests.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error to be returned on the next GetAgentStatus call in the fake client.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Returns the pre-configured status response or error, mimicking the real agent client's behavior.

methods.name: GetMCPHealth
methods.description: Stub method returning nil, for testing purposes.

methods.name: RestartMCPServer
methods.description: Stub method that simulates restarting the MCP server, returning nil.

methods.name: GetMCPTools
methods.description: Stub method returning nil, for testing.

methods.name: ShutdownAgent
methods.description: Stub method simulating agent shutdown, returning nil.

methods.name: setupStatusManagerStorage
methods.description: Initializes and returns a local storage provider configured for testing, skipping the test if sqlite3 FTS5 is unavailable.

methods.name: registerTestAgent
methods.description: Registers a test agent with specified nodeID in the storage. Sets default agent properties.

methods.name: ptrAgentState
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the provided AgentState.

methods.name: TestStatusManagerCachingAndFallback
methods.description: Tests caching behavior and fallback logic in case of errors or cache expiry.

methods.name: TestStatusManagerAllowsInactiveToActiveTransition
methods.description: Verifies that an agent status can transition from inactive to active.

methods.name: TestStatusManagerSnapshotUsesStorage
methods.description: Checks that status snapshots use storage and caching functions correctly.

methods.name: TestStatusManagerBroadcastsNodeOfflineEvent
methods.description: Ensures that transitioning a node from active to inactive publishes the correct event.

methods.name: TestStatusManagerBroadcastsNodeOnlineEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a node transitioning from inactive to active causes proper event broadcasts.

methods.name: TestStatusManagerPreservesOldStatusForEventBroadcast
methods.description: Confirms that the old status is correctly preserved and passed during status change events.

methods.name: onStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked during status changes to record and verify status transitions in tests.
